source_title: Webflow AEO: coming soon for Enterprise
claim_summary: Vendor announces an agent-driven answer-engine-optimization product (analytics, recommendations, agent-executed site changes) as coming soon for Enterprise
limitation: Announcement page only; availability followed on May 21 (see CI2026-030-007); no independent accuracy evidence

source_title: April 14 outage: what happened, and what's next
claim_summary: CTO postmortem: a CMS database cluster hit an undocumented cloud-provider logical-storage cap; about 96% of customers restored by 16:21 UTC, remaining ~4% of the affected cluster later; vendor reports no CMS data loss and lists sharding and circuit-breaker remediations
feature: hosted sites, Designer, Data API, forms
limitation: Vendor-authored root cause; cloud provider not named and not independently confirmed; remediation items are commitments not verified delivery

source_title: v1.14.0: Unified authentication across all CLI commands
claim_summary: Single OAuth login replaces separate site/workspace tokens and writes WEBFLOW_API_TOKEN to the project .env file; legacy token variables deprecated
limitation: A plaintext token in .env is a secret-handling surface for coding agents that read project files; no security review performed here

source_title: v1.19.0: DevLink export
claim_summary: webflow devlink export generates a static self-contained bundle of Webflow components as local React code (TS/JS) with no build-time connection to Webflow; CI token supported
limitation: Export fidelity, license of generated code and lock-in were not tested; exported runtime may still depend on Webflow packages

source_title: Introducing AI code components
claim_summary: Vendor says anyone can prompt the AI Assistant to generate reusable on-brand React code components on the component canvas and refine them in chat or code
availability: vendor-stated available; AI credit consumption applies from Jun 29
limitation: No independent quality, accessibility or security test of generated components; reuse claim is vendor wording

source_title: We're updating our pricing - and simplifying our plans at the same time
claim_summary: CMS and Business plans merged into Premium ($25/mo yearly, $39/mo monthly; 20,000 CMS items); Basic to $15/$25; new Team plan; AI credits in every Workspace; existing sites change at renewal on/after Jun 29 (agency/freelancer workspaces Nov 16); Business bandwidth 100GB to 50GB
availability: new purchases immediately; existing sites staged
limitation: Per-customer cost impact varies; third-party reports of large increases (nocode.tech) were seen only as search snippets and are unverified

source_title: Webflow AEO: Now available for Enterprise
claim_summary: AEO analytics plus AEO agents available to Enterprise; analytics requires latest Analyze for Enterprise; not sold standalone
limitation: CMSWire same-day article relays vendor claims and a vendor-commissioned survey; no independent accuracy or outcome test

source_title: CLI v2.0.0: Renamed commands and Node.js 22 minimum version
claim_summary: Major CLI release renames library commands to devlink commands (old names deprecated) and raises minimum Node.js to 22.13.0
limitation: Breaking changes impose script/CI migration work; actual downstream breakage not measured

source_title: Streamlined deployment for Webflow Cloud applications
claim_summary: Astro and Next.js apps can be deployed from a GitHub repository to Webflow Cloud via a deploy button, and apps no longer need to be linked to a Webflow site
limitation: Runtime limits, pricing and portability of Webflow Cloud apps not assessed

source_title: Track AI and MCP changes in your Site Activity Log
claim_summary: Activity log records whether a change came from a human, Webflow AI or an MCP-connected tool such as Cursor or Claude
limitation: Attribution completeness and tamper resistance not independently tested

source_title: AI credit limits are now in effect
claim_summary: Usage of AI features now counts against plan-included credits; monthly reset for self-serve, annual for Team/Enterprise; usage dashboard and paid top-ups
limitation: Credit-to-task conversion and cost per accepted change unknown; credits are not an energy measure

source_title: Webflow is now available in ChatGPT
claim_summary: Webflow app in ChatGPT can audit SEO/content, create and update CMS content after the user grants site access; vendor says no AI credits consumed at present
availability: available; no additional cost at publication
limitation: Depends on OpenAI platform terms; permission scope and error rate untested

source_title: Reports of some missing tooling from the Webflow MCP Server
claim_summary: Five MCP data tools (CMS, pages, scripts, element, variable) missing for some Claude Desktop users; workaround via Claude CLI; resolved same day with a connector tool-list refresh
limitation: Status page is vendor-authored; client-side cause (Claude app) vs server side not independently established; a related entry recurred Jul 9

source_title: Introducing MCP 2.0
claim_summary: MCP 2.0 adds design-system/component/CMS build tools, Agent Instructions, Analyze queries, branch-based work, role and permission enforcement and MCP action logging; bridge app no longer needed for most tasks; available to all users at no extra cost
limitation: Hosted remote server; public MIT webflow/mcp-server repo shows no default-branch commit after 2026-04-10 (checked 2026-10-16) so 2.x code is not observably open on the default branch; non-default branches were pushed as late as 2026-10-06 (repo pushed_at), which this screen did not inspect; CMSWire relays undefined vendor adoption metrics

source_title: Now available: AEO content optimization agents
claim_summary: Agents surface content opportunities and generate briefs and drafts intended to be cited by answer engines
limitation: Citation uplift and content quality are vendor claims; risk of low-value generated content not assessed

source_title: ctxcop v0.1.0
claim_summary: First public release of an MIT-licensed CLI that installs PreToolUse-style hooks in Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Pi, OpenCode and Aider to redact credentials from tool output before it reaches the model
limitation: Regex/keyword redaction can miss secrets; no independent recall test; early 0.x version; GitHub release timestamp is publisher-controlled metadata

source_title: Webflow is now available in Codex
claim_summary: MCP-powered Webflow capabilities and built-in skills (site audits, content management, development) available in OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT
limitation: Third-party platform availability, permissions and skill quality not tested

source_title: New: Branch API (beta)
claim_summary: Beta Data API endpoints to list, create, update, merge, publish and delete page branches with async task polling and conflict listing
availability: beta; Enterprise sites with page branching
limitation: Beta interface may change; merge-conflict semantics untested

source_title: Introducing Source by Webflow: where marketers and agents run the web
claim_summary: New platform where agents work directly on code (code as source of truth) with a visual canvas, role-specific Views, approvals and audit trails; connects to non-Webflow codebases; phased enrollment of select partners and customers
availability: limited research preview; no pricing or GA date
limitation: Customer quotes are agency partners; no public access, pricing or independent test; migration path for existing sites promised only

source_title: The biggest announcements from Webflow Conf 2026
claim_summary: Keynote says Campaigns is in beta and purchasable next month; Assets (Vidoso technology) enters beta in October; Releases site branching in beta later this year; MCP 2.1 to everyone later this month; external-agent access to AEO data later this year
limitation: Forward-looking statements; only MCP 2.1 (CI2026-030-024) and AEO Analytics API beta (CI2026-030-026) observed delivered in window; Campaigns purchase, Assets beta and Releases not verified

source_title: A new workspace for Marketing - Webflow takes on agentic IDEs with Source
claim_summary: Trade-press author saw a demonstration; reports research-preview status, notes setup/configuration effort and expects GA to be some time away
limitation: Demo-based impression, no benchmark or customer outcome; largely relays vendor framing

source_title: Reports of 500 intermittent errors affecting some hosted sites
claim_summary: Intermittent 500 errors in four short windows between 08:29 and 09:40 UTC, predominantly on recently published sites; resolved
limitation: Vendor-authored status record; affected-site count not disclosed; root cause not published

source_title: v2.8.0: webflow apps, the canonical namespace for Webflow Cloud
claim_summary: New webflow apps command family for the Cloud app lifecycle with --json reads, --dry-run on every write, predictable exit codes and bounded 429 retry, explicitly designed for CI and AI agents; webflow cloud commands deprecated
limitation: Second command-namespace change in four months; agent-friendliness not independently measured

source_title: MCP v2.1: Interactions with GSAP, Webflow Cloud, and Campaigns
claim_summary: Adds agent tools for Interactions with GSAP, Webflow Cloud deploy/debug and Campaigns, full branch lifecycle, CMS field groups and custom-field filtering, agent-generated instructions; states no tool names changed from v2.0.1
limitation: Hosted server, version not visible in public repo; changelog calls GSAP open source while GSAP standard license is proprietary no-charge (see report)

source_title: v2.9.0: Workspace folders for imported apps, and devlink sync removed
claim_summary: Removes the deprecated webflow devlink sync command; adds --folder-id for apps imported from GitHub; fixes Server bundle manifest listing
limitation: Removal can break pinned scripts; downstream impact unmeasured

source_title: New: AEO Analytics API (beta)
claim_summary: Beta Data API endpoints for AI bot traffic, tracked prompts and executions, visibility and citations for sites with the AEO analytics entitlement
limitation: Partly delivers the Sep 2 promise of external-agent AEO data access; GA entry dated Oct 13 is outside window; metric validity unknown

source_title: Update: Get Site Plan returns the Starter hosting plan and public plan names
claim_summary: Get Site Plan now returns hosting-starter-v1/Starter for unpaid sites and public plan names in displayName; vendor labels it a breaking change
limitation: Integrations comparing id/displayName must be updated; number of affected integrations unknown
